title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G021
note: Single-case regression for the India completed-order count alias.

cases.question: How many completed orders were placed by customers from India?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND c.country = 'India';
